# Vendored themes

Regenerate with `cicd/win/vendor-themes.bash` - do not hand-edit.

Fluent GTK + icon themes by vinceliuice, **GPL-3.0**, bundled as mere aggregation
(runtime data, not linked into nemo). Each theme keeps its `COPYING`.

- `themes/Fluent` <- https://github.com/vinceliuice/Fluent-gtk-theme @ `5d3651f4520f1d30d5420c717fb9d5e077f67fe8`
- `icons/Fluent`  <- https://github.com/vinceliuice/Fluent-icon-theme @ `c70c2441bcf2ab8bbc267e55635c76d69f659a8b` (file-manager subset)
